author: root_pi
question: Can a small train-only recession test compare one and two storage time scales under a fixed forcing and flow measurement contract?
hypothesis: A source and QC contract may support a later short-window predictive comparison; readiness is currently unresolved.

sources.note: Primary CAMELS source paper and local manifests were reviewed during screening.
Official versioned source metadata identifies the large archive; no new archive acquisition is selected.

measurement: Daily forcing and gauged flow require area conversion, zero/missing/censoring rules and a documented QC contract. The A:< token remains unresolved.
independent_unit: Basin for spatial transfer; preserve time dependence and whole recession windows within each basin.
baseline: Later direct exponential regression or likelihood, before any ABC comparison.
reference: Later analytic curve and tractable observation likelihood; no reference implementation or numerical study selected now.
split: Preserve existing 36 train, 12 selection and 16 external basin groups. External observations remain sealed. No event selection from held-out flow.
cheap_test: HOLD. Before a separate stage, scope a metadata/QC and precipitation-only window contract using the existing manifest. Do not download or parse the large archive now.
risks: Window selection, snow and human-impact scope are not frozen.
A two-reservoir model can have weak amplitude/rate directions.
Archive acquisition is a new cost and has no allocation in this card.
